integrity: The lower bound is proved for every real cutting hyperplane by reducing an off-center cut to a contained central half-cube and giving explicit point pairs at distance at least three in two exhaustive normal-vector regimes. The upper bound is an explicit coordinate midplane cut. The standalone exact-rational checker tests the proof formulas but is not used as a substitute for the continuum argument.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only two-piece hyperplane divisions of the three-dimensional cube. It does not classify all optimal cuts or determine the corresponding values for higher dimensions, more pieces, or general orthotopes. A differently phrased or unindexed prior observation remains a residual originality risk. The recorded first public day is the earliest exact public day verified; a 2022 abstract cites a 2021 preprint but no exact 2021 public day was verified.
title: Sharp two-piece min-max diameter of the three-dimensional cube
